text: The upgrade of the National Disaster Centre’s Information Management System (IMS) in Papua New Guinea is a key component of the EU-funded Building Safety and Resilience in the Pacific Phase II (BSRP II) programme. This initiative aims to enhance the country's disaster management capabilities by integrating advanced data collection, hazard monitoring, and communication systems. The IMS will serve as the central hub for aggregating and analyzing hazard data, facilitating real-time decision-making, and improving communication with remote communities and at-risk groups.
